sections.section_title: FLASH write page protection for bank2 (FLASH_WRP2R_PRG)
sections.text_helper: Section 6.10.34 "FLASH write page protection for bank2 (FLASH_WRP2R_PRG)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 200.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x1EC
Reset value: 0xXXXX XXXX
This register can be protected against unprivileged access when PRIV = 1
inFLASH_PRIVCFGR.
This register is used to program values in corresponding option bits.
Bits 31:0 WRPSG2[31:0]: Bank2 page protection option status byte
Setting WRPSG2 bits to 0 write protects the corresponding pages in bank 2
0: write protected;
1: not write protected
Note: Refer to Table29: Write-protection management group definition.
